purpose: DETECT revenue at risk BEFORE a failure webhook exists. Rules evaluate periodic snapshots of subscriptions / tokens / invoices / orders (what you would poll from Razorpay APIs) and emit `risk.*` events. Each risk event opens a case in the normal loop with decline_family=pre_failure (recurring) or a non-recurring domain, so the shield + planner + ledger apply unchanged.

meta.input: snapshot events: { event: 'snapshot', entity_type: subscription|token|invoice|order, entity: {...}, occurred_at }
meta.output: risk events: { event: 'risk.<rule_id>', domain, subscription_id|invoice_id|order_id, amount_paise, occurred_at, payload }
meta.evaluation: Every rule whose `when` matches emits one risk event (deduped per entity+rule per day via processed ids). Money-moving actions are blocked on all pre-failure / non-recurring cases by the shield.

domains.checkout: one-off order abandoned before payment (no mandate; comms + consent rules apply)
domains.receivables: B2B/B2C invoices approaching or past due (no mandate; comms + consent rules apply)

rules.source: Card networks decline charges on expired cards (hard decline). RBI tokenization: token expiry follows card expiry; merchant must collect fresh card + AFA.
RBI e-mandate: a mandate has a fixed validity; debits after end date are rejected. Renewal requires fresh AFA.
NPCI UPI AutoPay / RBI e-mandate: debit above the registered max amount is rejected. Needs mandate modification with AFA.
RBI E-mandate Framework - recurring debits above Rs 15,000 (general) need per-transaction AFA; a silent debit will be rejected.
rules.suggested_path: dunning_email / whatsapp with AFA link ahead of charge date

rules.source: Razorpay Subscriptions: `pending` means a charge failed and retries are in progress; 72h without a webhook usually means a missed/undelivered webhook.
rules.note: Reuses the reactive class so the same priors apply; origin=detector distinguishes it in the report.

rules.source: Receivables practice: a reminder 1-3 days before due date is the cheapest intervention; MSMED Act 2006 s.15 caps agreed credit at 45 days for MSME suppliers.
Receivables: overdue invoice. Escalation ladder email -> whatsapp -> AR human. Interest per MSMED Act s.16 where applicable.
Razorpay Magic Checkout / abandoned-cart recovery: order created or attempted but not paid. Contact requires prior consent (DPDPA) and TRAI comms rules.
rules.suggested_path: dunning_email / dunning_whatsapp with payment link; no debit possible
